notes: al-Faqih states his route («رويته») to a book, with no saying: needs_ruling (rule 11).
«أبي» here is the compiler's father, bare: relation (rule 7). Occurrence 2 because the same token begins «أبي المغراء» in the opening.
Abu al-Mughira's name stands twice; occurrence 2 is the chain's own. «عربي كوفي ثقة وله كتاب» is a remark: left out.
